claim: The Bund is a free 24-hour public waterfront promenade where sunset-to-blue-hour is the strongest photo window; walk north from East Nanjing Road Station (Line 2/10, Exit 2) toward Waibaidu Bridge for layered facade-and-skyline shots, pairing it with East Nanjing Road in one evening route.
quote: sunset to blue hour is the strongest window for photos ... free public waterfront promenade ... East Nanjing Road Station (Line 2/10, Exit 2) — best entry point ... pairing The Bund with East Nanjing Road in one continuous evening route

claim: Shanghai Tower's 118th-floor observation deck (Top of Shanghai Observatory) is open 08:30-21:30 with adult tickets normally RMB 180.
quote: Shanghai Tower 118th Floor Observation Deck is open from 08:30-21:30 ... the normal entry price for adults is ¥180, with holiday prices at ¥199

claim: Yu Garden opens 09:00-16:30 (ticketing stops 16:00), closed Mondays except National Day, admission RMB 40 (Apr-Jun, Sep-Nov) or RMB 30 (Jul-Aug, Dec-Mar); the adjacent Yuyuan Bazaar and the night-lit Nine Bend Bridge are free.
quote: 09:00 - 16:30 (Ticketing stops at 16:00); Closed on Mondays ... April-June & Sept-Nov | 40 ... July-Aug & Dec-March | 30 ... Nine Bend Bridge offers free nighttime viewing with colorful lighting outside paid garden areas

claim: The Oriental Pearl Tower is open daily 09:00-21:00 (last entry 20:30); the Double Sphere ticket is RMB 199 and the Triple Sphere (top deck) RMB 299, with evening visits and 7:30/8:30/9:30 PM light shows recommended.
quote: daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, with last entry at 8:30 PM ... Double Sphere Ticket: ¥199 ... Triple Sphere Ticket: ¥299 ... scheduled light shows at 7:30 PM, 8:30 PM, and 9:30 PM

claim: Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street is a free pedestrian-only zone running ~1200m from People's Square to the Bund, lined with department stores and time-honored shops, most lively at night.
quote: The pedestrian section is about 1200 meters long, stretching from People's Square in the west to the Bund in the east ... Nanjing Road is most lively and charming at night.

claim: Best times for Nanjing Road are weekday mornings (10am-12pm) or after 8pm for the lights, avoiding weekends, lunch (12-2pm) and dinner rush (6-8pm); People's Square (Line 1/2/8) anchors its western end.
quote: Best time to visit is weekday mornings (10am-12pm) or after 8pm for lights. Avoid weekends, holidays, lunch hours (12-2pm), dinner rush (6-8pm)
